entities.name: Arabidopsis PDCB3
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q9FZ86, PLASMODESMATA CALLOSE-BINDING PROTEIN 3, at 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Contains an X8 domain at residues 20–91, consistent with polysaccharide/callose-associated binding.
N-terminal signal peptide directs entry into the secretory pathway; C-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with a GPI-anchor signal rather than a conventional cytosolic transmembrane domain.
Localized to the plasma membrane and plasmodesmata; annotated for extracellular region, beta-1,3-glucan binding, and polysaccharide binding.

entities.name: X8 domain
observations: Pfam PF07983 detected at residues 20–91 with i-Evalue 7.7e-22.
X8 domains are associated with carbohydrate/polysaccharide-binding proteins, including callose-binding proteins.

entities.name: Plant plasmodesma
observations: PDCB3 is annotated as localized to plasmodesmata, intercellular channels in plants.
